acceptanceCriteria: No git subprocess runs while the writer lock is held on the lease writer route, or a measurement shows its bound.
A concurrency test blocks the git step and shows other writers still commit.
body: Found 2026-10-20 by pre-1.0 lanes on origin/main 7d78a56b0 / a148e3a92, Corvint build 695, Darwin arm64, go1.27.3. V1-1656 lane moved the identity probe out of the lock but noted that claim-fact git calls still run under the writer lock, so a slow git blocks every queue writer. Suspected contributor to V1-1512 p99.

title: Lease writer route still runs git (claim facts) under the writer lock
